comparison.objective: Move a heavy mortar to a marked area while keeping or restoring its loose pestle inside; the candidate configures a gripper mechanism.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2272 tests coordinated transport of a heavy container with an unstable loose load; the candidate tests precision tool seating, coupled screw/nut torque, and functional actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2272 requires target placement, pestle containment, stability, and robot clearance; the candidate requires a locked 90° setting retained over three cycles with low drift.
comparison.reason: Managing a loose load during transport does not test preservation of a threaded calibration under locknut reaction.
